method: The bead field is a rectangular loom grid. In target-size mode, columns are the target width divided by nominal bead width and rows are target length divided by nominal bead length, each rounded to the nearest whole bead with a minimum of one. Existing-grid mode uses the entered whole-number columns and rows directly. Finished dimensions are columns times bead width and rows times bead length. Pattern beads are columns times rows; beads to have add the selected spare percentage and round up to a whole bead. Warp strand count is columns plus one. Each cut warp strand is the beaded length plus the entered allowance at both ends; total warp multiplies that cut length by strand count, and the spare warp total applies the same percentage. Project dimensions and allowances accept millimetres, centimetres or inches, converted with 1 in = 25.4 mm and 1 cm = 10 mm. Nominal bead dimensions are user-supplied; clasp, finishing and bead-to-bead variation are excluded.
